drg.description: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease without CC/MCC

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 72-year-old male admitted for COPD exacerbation. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.76, creatinine 2.19, hemoglobin 13, platelets 308, sodium 140, wbc 9.2; vitals dbp 69-73, heart_rate 70-73, map 86-88, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 116-120, spo2 96-97, temp 36.5-36.7
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 2.15, hemoglobin 13.1, platelets 311, sodium 140, wbc 9.1; vitals dbp 68-73, heart_rate 68-73, map 86-89, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 119-123, spo2 96-97, temp 36.5-36.6
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 72-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: COPD exacerbation. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
